dates.label: Prohibited AI practices (Art. 5), including inferring emotions of people at work or in education (Art. 5(1)(f)), apply
dates.note: Art. 5(1)(f) wording checked on the Commission AI Act Service Desk (consolidated text as at 27 July 2026). Date confirmed by FPF and Gibson Dunn.

dates.label: AI literacy (Art. 4) applies: providers and deployers take measures to support the development of AI literacy of their staff
dates.note: Wording as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, quoted by FPF ("shall take measures to support the development of AI literacy"). Not yet checked against the EUR-Lex body text, which could not be fetched.

dates.label: Transparency obligations (Art. 50) apply
dates.note: Confirmed by FPF and Gibson Dunn; unchanged by the omnibus.

dates.label: Machine-readable marking of AI-generated content (Art. 50(2)) applies to generative AI systems placed on the market before 2 Aug 2026
dates.note: Grace period added by the omnibus (new Art. 111(4), as reported by Gibson Dunn and euai-act.com). Not yet checked against the EUR-Lex body text.

dates.label: High-risk obligations for Annex III systems apply (postponed by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)
dates.note: Confirmed by FPF and Gibson Dunn.

dates.label: High-risk obligations for Annex I (product-embedded) systems apply (postponed by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744)
dates.note: Confirmed by FPF and Gibson Dunn.
